sources.snippet: The fine-tuned model performs on par with its base (67.31% vs. 67.23%, a +0.08 pt gap — 5 of 6200 questions, within run-to-run noise). This is the expected outcome: the LoRA adapter was trained on the bilingual (Turkish and English) seasoned-advice conversational dataset, a domain unrelated to Turkish MMLU's academic and professional knowledge.
